public_health_question.v: What were the epidemiologic, clinical and genomic characteristics of a statewide serogroup Y meningococcal disease outbreak in Virginia, and how was it controlled without a defined population at risk?

ev.q: Patients lacked common exposures or affiliations. Vaccination was recommended for close contacts within the patient age range.

conditions.v: invasive meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis serogroup Y)

ev.q: Statewide Outbreak of Neisseria meningitidis Serogroup Y, Sequence Type 1466 — Virginia, 2022–2024
In August 2022, the Virginia Department of Health (VDH) began investigating an IMD outbreak in Virginia’s Eastern Health Planning Region.
VDH conducted active case finding by monitoring syndromic surveillance † and reviewing medical records of patients with suspected meningitis or meningococcemia.
VDH conducted standard public health interviews with patients to identify close contacts.

equity.level_reason: The outbreak is said to have disproportionately affected Black persons and patients' tract SVI is set beside the state value, but both are side-by-side shares or averages (83% vs 12%; 0.63 vs 0.4) with no computed difference or ratio, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Disparity is framed and interpreted, and social vulnerability, access to medical care and shared social networks are named as explanations; a looser reading of the side-by-side contrast as quantified gives 3, plus determinants gives 4.

ev.q: residence of patients in areas of higher social vulnerability might have been associated with challenges in accessing medical care, increasing the likelihood of poor outcomes.
This finding might reflect carriage of NmY ST1466 among contacts of a shared social network.

equity.equity_measurement: Race share of cases is compared with the Southwest Region population share; tract-level SVI averages are compared with the Virginia average (0.4). Only two race groups appear in the table.

notes: Outbreak report of 36 cases; contrasts are against external referents (national CFR range, state SVI average, regional population share, 10-year case average) with no computed differences or tests. Prepass 'diagnostic_accuracy' is a false hit (antibiotic sensitivity). Vaccination status of cases and anecdotal low vaccine acceptance are context, so vaccine_outcome_type is null.
